name.en: Certificate for a university entrance qualification

value.quotedAs: Certificate for a university entrance qualification

evidence.quote: Certificate for a university entrance qualification (please find more information at uni-assist)

notes: Les frais de scolarité indiqués (500 EUR/semestre) concernent les étudiants internationaux de pays tiers. La durée de 8 semestres correspond à 4 ans (210 ECTS). Les langues d'enseignement couvrent l'anglais (début) et l'allemand (à partir du 4e semestre). Les documents listés pour l'admission incluent le certificat de qualification d'entrée à l'université (mentionné dans la page du programme). Les exigences de stage et de langue sont des conditions d'admission avec des preuves. L'application pour les candidats internationaux se fait via uni-assist.

evidence.quote: German language skills at level A2 The following apply as proof of required German language skills for language level A2: German-language university entrance qualification Certificate of an assessment test to determine the eligibility of foreign applicants to study at institutions of higher education in the Federal Republic of Germany (= Feststellungsprüfung) Completed German-language Bachelor's or Master's degree Completed German studies university degree in Germany or abroad International university entrance qualification plus at least two years of secondary education at a German-speaking school. (Proof must be provided by uploading two annual school reports.) German at level A in the final certificate of the International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme For students at Rosenheim University of Applied Sciences: Successful completion of the following four modules at Rosenheim University of Applied Sciences: a) German B2.1 b) German B2.2 c) Technical German 1 – B2/C1 d) Technical German 2 – B2/C1 German Language Diploma DSD Level 1 (CEFR Level A2/B1) or higher Goethe Certificate A2 or higher TELC Certificate A2 or higher ÖSD Certificate A2 or higher German Language Examination for University Admission DSH 1 or higher Test of German as a Foreign Language TestDaF TDN 3 or higher DTZ (German Test for Immigrants Level A2/B1) Completion of German courses at a university in Germany worth at least 4 ECTS credits at level A2 or higher according to CEFR Proof of language proficiency must be provided before the start of the programme.

note.fr: Un stage préalable obligatoire de 8 semaines minimum (Vorpraxis) doit être effectué avant le début du programme ou au plus tard au début du 4e semestre.
note.en: A mandatory preliminary internship of at least 8 weeks must be completed before the start of the programme or at latest by the beginning of the 4th semester.

evidence.quote: Preliminary internship The study of Plastics Engineering requires an internship of at least 8 weeks.
